title: MiaoMiao (Libre) BG reading time
body:
Is it possible to change the period time of BG reading ? In the Glimp App you can manage the BG reading time. This helps to clear the noise effect of the BG readings.
The BG value of my miaomiao is often read only every 10 to 14 minutes and this period im my opinion is too long.
